entries.279a463727936b86: This is the core business, which carries out repair and renovation work on exterior walls and interiors of general houses, apartment buildings, commercial buildings, historic buildings, roads, bridges and other structures, using the proprietary "Home Makeover Method" that applies specialty functional coatings. There are two approaches: a direct method, in which the company contracts directly with general contractors and building owners, and an alliance method, in which certified FC member stores contract with the client; the company provides a 10-year quality guarantee after construction. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥4,803 million.

entries.2b350080db742a2d: The reportable segments are the Home Makeup Business and the Building Construction Business, 2 in total, and the composition is combined with “Other,” which is not included in the reportable segments. For the fiscal year ended May 2026, external revenue of the Home Makeup Business was ¥4,803 million, accounting for most of the total, while the Building Construction Business was ¥188 million and Other was ¥38 million. All revenue is domestic; there is no revenue from external customers outside Japan, and no major customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue. The number of employees assigned to the Home Makeup Business is 92.

entries.a8d22635f91f6965: It is distinguished by a one-stop service in which it handles everything from scaffolding to plastering, waterproofing and water-stopping, painting and sealing entirely in-house, making clear where responsibility lies and how prices are structured. It has the proprietary Home Makeup Method, consisting of special functional paints and 4 construction techniques, and provides a 10-year quality guarantee after construction. It does not conduct door-to-door sales; its basic approach is sales through a network of partnerships with local prime contractors and design offices, and, under its own management, it outsources part of the work to certified construction stores to respond to fluctuations in demand.

entries.d5bbead47b36f949: Using the proprietary “Home Makeup Method,” which uses special functional paints, it carries out repair and renovation work on the exterior walls and interiors of deteriorated buildings, and also undertakes new construction and renovation work using general construction methods.
entries.d86ef8d65f299ea6: It is a company that earns revenue from renovation work that restores the exterior walls and interiors of buildings using special functional paints and proprietary construction techniques, and from providing know-how to FC member stores and selling materials.
entries.e4faac7393acd32a: To roll out the Home Makeup Method nationwide, it says it will step up efforts to open new branches in major urban areas across the country and company-operated stores, and will advance strengthening relationships with existing partners and developing partners in new areas. It aims for market penetration of Skeleton Disaster-Prevention Coating and entry into the large-scale repair work market, and says it will strengthen technical capabilities through improvements to Skeleton Disaster-Prevention Coating and cost reductions, and through improved construction management and quality and technology, and will thoroughly implement an order policy that emphasizes construction profitability.
entries.edd831f4868a42f2: It is a non-consolidated company headquartered in Ube, Yamaguchi Prefecture, and its employee count for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was 103. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market and the Fukuoka Stock Exchange Q-Board Market.
